color.$description: Palette C (decision 10). Primitives hold the only hex values; themes reference them. AMBER RULE: amber is for fills and decoration only, never text or UI boundaries on the light ground (2.5:1 on paper; 6.1:1 on ink).

ink.$description: Text on paper, the dark ground, and the text and mark colour on an amber fill (about 6.1:1).

muted.$description: Secondary text on paper (5.5:1). On ink it is only 2.8:1, so the dark theme uses muted-dark.

grid.$description: Hairlines and grid edges on paper. Decoration, about 1.4:1 on paper.

amber.$description: AMBER RULE: signal amber is for fills and decoration only. 2.5:1 on paper, so never text or UI boundaries on the light ground; 6.1:1 on ink.

fish-band.$description: The clownfish band: 70% paper over amber. 1.9:1 against the body, decoration only.

on-amber-white.$description: ON-AMBER RULE: on amber, white takes the accent role (decoration, the fish body), about 2.5:1 so never text. Also the light card surface.

card-dark.$description: Dark theme card surface (motion board starting value, proven by the contrast check).

muted-dark.$description: Dark theme secondary text (motion board starting value, proven by the contrast check).

accent-text-dark.$description: Dark theme amber text (motion board starting value, proven by the contrast check).

accent-on-amber.$description: ON-AMBER RULE, decoration only: white takes the accent role on an amber fill (the amber echo, the fish body). About 2.5:1 on amber, so it is never text; text on amber is on-accent (ink).

card.$description: Light card surface, the motion board's card colour.

accent-fill.$description: AMBER RULE: a fill and decoration colour only; never text or UI boundaries on the light ground (2.5:1 on paper). Text on it is on-accent.

on-accent.$description: ON-AMBER RULE: text and the logo mark on an amber fill are ink (about 6.1:1). White on amber (accent-on-amber) is decoration only.

muted.$description: The dark theme's own muted: the light muted is 2.8:1 on ink.

accent-fill.$description: AMBER RULE: a fill and decoration colour. Amber is 6.1:1 on ink, but text uses accent-text, and on the light ground amber is never text or a boundary. Text on it is on-accent.

on-accent.$description: ON-AMBER RULE: text and the logo mark on an amber fill are ink (about 6.1:1). White on amber (accent-on-amber) is decoration only.
